description: Election Commission - S. N. Ramanayaka was Selected as the Member of the Ja-ela P.S., M. S. P. Perera was Selected as the Member of the Ja-ela Urban Council
reasoning: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Ja-ela Pradeshiya Sabha and Ja-ela Urban Council) due to members ceasing to belong to their political parties. It involves the electoral process under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, including the nomination and declaration of new members to fill these vacancies. This falls squarely under election-related matters, specifically addressing electoral procedures and member replacements in local government bodies.
